caption: The drawing depicts a botanical composition consisting of two large, central flowers with five red petals each and white and yellow centers, surrounded by several smaller flowers and buds in shades of red, white, and yellow. The main stems and leaves are rendered in blue and green tones, with the leaves exhibiting gradient shades of green and blue, some with dark accents. There is also a prominent butterfly on the left side, featuring wings with yellow, red, green, and a light tan outline. The background is a plain, off-white or beige fabric with visible fine texture, and the design is executed in a style that mimics embroidery, with visible thread-like strokes indicating stitching. The composition is slightly asymmetrical, with the central flowers and leaves spreading outward, and the smaller flowers and buds scattered along the branching stems.
title: Coverlet
